proof: For every admitted actual behavior row, exactly one action has probability 1 and all others have probability 0.
Every accepted candidate or baseline evaluation action with nonzero probability must have nonzero original behavior probability.
Because each arm is also deterministic, both arms must equal that row's sole behavior action, or OPE rejects UnsupportedAction.
On every successful row, importance weight is exactly 1, IPS contribution is outcome y, and DR contribution is m+1*(y-m)=y. SNIPS is the same sample mean.
Original shared behavior, finalized Outcome and Outcome evidence are equal between arms. Therefore all three point estimates match.
Each conservative confidence interval contains its point. Candidate.lower-baseline.upper (or baseline.lower-candidate.upper for Minimize) is nonpositive.
Every valid frozen role contract includes a PrimarySuperiority with nonnegative margin and a strict comparison. It cannot pass. More rows or a later clock does not change this conclusion.
Body signatures, role separation, native journals and receipt windows remain necessary, but none changes this statistical impossibility.
